# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/autorestic
# args: 
Documentation:	https://autorestic.vercel.app
Support:	https://discord.gg/wS7RpYTYd2

Usage:
  autorestic [command]

Available Commands:
  backup      Create backups for given locations
  check       Check if everything is setup
  completion  Generate completion script
  cron        Run cron job for automated backups
  exec        Execute arbitrary native restic commands for given backends
  forget      Forget and optionally prune snapshots according the specified policies
  help        Help about any command
  info        Show info about the config
  install     Install restic if missing
  restore     Restore backup for location
  uninstall   Uninstall restic and autorestic
  unlock      Unlock autorestic only if you are sure that no other instance is running
  upgrade     Upgrade autorestic and restic

Flags:
      --ci                    CI mode disabled interactive mode and colors and enables verbosity
  -c, --config string         config file (default is $HOME/.autorestic.yml or ./.autorestic.yml)
      --docker-image string   specify a custom docker image (default "cupcakearmy/autorestic:1.8.3")
  -h, --help                  help for autorestic
      --restic-bin string     specify custom restic binary (default "restic")
  -v, --verbose               verbose mode
      --version               version for autorestic

Use "autorestic [command] --help" for more information about a command.
